summary: More Ansible 11 community.aws changes: ec2_vpc_nacl_info, ec2_vpc_peer, ec2_vpc_peering_info, ec2_vpc_vgw(_info), ec2_vpc_vpn(_info) and elb_classic_lb_info moved to amazon.aws, ecs_cluster purge_capacity_providers now defaults to true, and iam_policy dropped connection_properties for raw_connection_properties.
questions: Where did ec2_vpc_peer move in Ansible 11?
What is the new default of purge_capacity_providers in ecs_cluster?
